module: Race path class: container of pathnodes, segments, start positions (startPositions) and pacenotes, with metadata (name, authors, difficulty, default laps, prefabs). It builds a route configuration (autoConfig: segment graph, branching, closed circuit, linear route), classifies it (classify), computes a path for the AI, serializes itself to JSON and can be converted from old formats (scenarios, scene checkpoints, 'tracks'). The module returns a factory: require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/race/path')(name). It is used by the race editor and by race.lua.
notes: init(name) ignores its argument: the name stays "Path" (hardcoded value). copy() passes a name, with no effect.
copy() is broken: it calls cpy.onDeserialized(self.onSerialize()) with a dot instead of a colon, so without self (Lua error).
autoConfig references a global variable reverse (never defined): targetNode is always seg.to.
autoConfig assumes there is only one first segment; startNode must exist (otherwise empty config).

classify() calls autoConfig then reads the startPositions and pathnodes of invalid ids: a 'missing' object is returned by sortedList for an absent id; classify fails if endNode matches nothing and the circuit is not validly closed.

Identifier fields: startNode, endNode, defaultStartPosition, reverseStartPosition, rollingStartPosition, rollingReverseStartPosition (-1 if not defined); prefab fields: prefabs, forwardPrefabs, reversePrefabs.
The four collections (pathnodes, segments, startPositions, pacenotes) are gameplay/util/sortedList with .objects (by id), .sorted (sorted list), create, clear.
postCreate: the first pathnode created becomes startNode, the first start position becomes defaultStartPosition.
getAiPath does not handle paths with branching; it uses map.findClosestRoad to associate each pathnode with a road node.
reverse() swaps from/to of all segments and swaps startNode/endNode (if endNode is defined); the startPositions do not change.

C.desc: Race path. Main fields: id, name, description, authors, date, difficulty (24 by default), defaultLaps (1), config (autoConfig result), simplifyAiPath, hideMission, isReversed, aiPath, aiDetailedPath, aiPathDistance.

getNextUniqueIdentifier.desc: Returns an increasing unique identifier for the path's objects.

init.desc: Constructor / reset: default values, empty collections. The name argument is ignored.

autoConfig.desc: Builds the automatic configuration in self.config: from the startNode, segment graph (successors, predecessors, lastInLap, targetNode, next visible segments), branching and closed indicators, linearPathnodes list for an unbranched route, and pacenotes associated with each segment (segmentToPacenotes).

findSegments.desc: Ids of the valid segments whose start equals from and/or whose end equals to (nil = no filter).

drawDebug.desc: Draws pathnodes, segments, start positions and pacenotes.

drawAiRouteDebug.desc: Draws the AI's detailed path (1 m spheres and colored prisms) if it exists.

getAiPath.desc: Computes the AI path from the configuration: list of road nodes (names) close to each pathnode, then detailed path via the route module. Returns two empty tables if the configuration is not ready. Stops at branchings.

returns.desc: Detailed path (points with pos and wp).

findStartPositionByName.desc: Looks for a start position by its name.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the path into a JSON table (metadata, collections, start/end ids, prefabs, classification, options).

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the path from serialized data (clears then recreates the collections, converts the ids with an oldIdMap table).

copy.desc: Intended to duplicate the path; broken in this version (see notes).

reverse.desc: Reverses the path direction: swaps startNode and endNode, swaps from/to of the segments, toggles isReversed.

fromLapConfig.desc: Resets the path and builds it from a list of checkpoints of an old scenario (positions read from the active scenario extensions.scenario_scenarios), linked in order by segments; the last one joins the first if closed.

fromCheckpointList.desc: Resets the path from scene objects (CameraBookmark/waypoints): one pathnode per object (radius = largest scale, normal if directionalWaypoint), segments in order.

fromTrack.desc: Resets the path from a track description (old format): start/finish line, lapConfig, optional prefabs (auto-detected _forward and _reverse), segments, metadata and start positions of the spawn spheres.

trackInfo.desc: Track data (originalInfo.lapConfig, startLineCheckpoint, finishLineCheckpoint, closed, spawnSpheres, prefabs, lapCount...).

usePrefabs.desc: true to temporarily spawn the prefabs during the conversion.

returns.desc: true if successful, nil if a checkpoint is not found.

classify.desc: Calls autoConfig and returns the path's classification: rolling start allowed, reversible, closed, branching.

recalculateSegments.desc: Recreates the segments by linking the pathnodes in sorted order.

getLastPathnode.desc: Last pathnode of the sorted list.
